install: export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; test "$(node --version)" = "v$(cat .nvmrc)" && npm ci && npm run build:cached && node scripts/rea.mjs mcp doctor --json && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && if [ -e "$HOME/.local/bin/rea-workbench" ]; then cp -p "$HOME/.local/bin/rea-workbench" "$HOME/.local/bin/rea-workbench.backup.$(date +%s)"; fi && printf '#!/bin/bash\nexec /usr/local/bin/node "%s/scripts/rea.mjs" "$@"\n' "$PWD" > "$HOME/.local/bin/rea-workbench" && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/rea-workbench"
